g1_verdict.interpretation: Every hypothesis failed to produce a single valid demand signal in 7 days. H1 (proposals) is the only motion that moved at all (1 proposal) but drew 0 reply; H2 (X) 0 reach; H3/H4 (passive) 0 inquiry. The goal missed not on execution volume but on demand reaching the company at all.
g1_verdict.root_cause: Two stacked causes. (1) CHANNEL/AUDIENCE MISFIT: the one active sales motion routes through Coconala 公開依頼, whose pool is structurally wrong for an honest solo-AI provider — ~67+ requests screened, 1 GO; the pool is creative-dominated (illustration/music/video/voice, out of lane), and its few in-lane requests either demand a multi-year human track record (false-claim barrier, PG-1 cond.4 — e.g. req 5309349) or are adjacent text tasks whose buyers explicitly reject AI-centered applicants (req 5310341). (2) ZERO OWNED DISTRIBUTION: no channel reaches target buyers at volume (X ~tiny followers, 0 profile_clicks; stores 0 traffic; the 3 Sept store checkouts all abandoned before payment). Not a product or price problem.
g1_verdict.decision: G1 marked FAILED. Do NOT continue the same strategy. Execute a portfolio redesign this fire (below) to maximize P(G2 by 10/20) / P(G3 by 10/31).
g1_verdict.resource_reallocation: CONCENTRATE on the active sales motion (buyer-posted requests) with WIDENED supply: (a) broaden the Coconala GO lane now [L2, gate-free, task h1-coconala-broaden-go]; (b) add CrowdWorks as a higher-volume, better-fit request board [L3, owner KYC filed]. SHRINK everything else to low-effort: STOP new note articles (month); demote X to credibility + a 10/09 reach test (not a revenue bet); stop active H3 listing work (keep live); stores zero-effort (keep live). Zenn book stays live (HTTP 200 10/07) as zero-cost supply. No new operator/agent (Art.6); mac-local remains the browser executor, Founder re-ranks.
g1_verdict.next_action: mac-local works h1-coconala-broaden-go (re-screen + ≤5/day proposals on the widened lane); Founder tracks the CrowdWorks KYC and, once live, opens that lane; each fire re-reads Stripe/Coconala/X for the first signal and acts end-to-end (Art.10).
g1_verdict.next_deadline: 2026-10-12 — ≥10 proposals on the widened Coconala lane with 0 replies → stop proposing on Coconala. 2026-10-13(+5d of a live CrowdWorks board) — ≥10 proposals & 0 replies → kill that board; both boards 0 at fair volume → proposal motion falsified → pivot L4. 2026-10-20 — G2 verdict (¥10,000 + net>0).
